verdict.rationale: BILL exposes a v3 REST API covering Spend & Expense (budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements), signed webhooks for event-driven automation, bulk/mass endpoints, and a sandbox for testing workflows without moving real money. Together these support headless, non-UI automation that could run in CI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling/docs, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), S&E-specific sandbox evidence (the sandbox docs describe AP flows), and independent hands-on corroboration.
